scripts.migrations:add: dotnet restore && dotnet ef migrations add --project src/CmsApi.Data --startup-project src/CmsApi --context WriteDbContext --output-dir Migrations
scripts.migrations:up: dotnet restore && dotnet ef database update --project src/CmsApi.Data --startup-project src/CmsApi --context WriteDbContext -- --environment Development
